annotations.title: Score my CV against a job

description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Scores how well the signed-in user's primary CV fits one open job (0–100, rule-based), with the required skills they match and miss. Limited to 30 matches per day per account, so use it for a job the user names; score_cv rates the CV itself and suggest_jobs_for_me finds jobs that fit it.

job_id.description: Job id from search_jobs, get_job or suggest_jobs_for_me results.

name: match_cv

detailed_review_url.description: Job page tab where the user can ask for a detailed AI review.

primary_cv.description: The CV chính that was scored: the one CV used for matching and referrals.
